query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.type, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news WHERE categoryId = c.id) as news_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles WHERE categoryId = c.id) as article_count
FROM categories c
ORDER BY c.type, c.name
